main_text.p: in nepotis locum succedens, recte instituitus iudicatur.
Esset adoptatus.) Sequitur 3. Pronepos in filij locum, etiam uno nepote, recte adoptatur.
main_text.head: ARGVMENTVM.
main_text.p: In omnibus Aquilianæ formulæ casibus, filius, qui modo in ciuitate sit, semper instituendus est, neque exheredari potest. Nepos autem & pronepos, dummodo eorum postumi instituantur, præteriri possunt.

„ In omnibus his speciebus „ illud seruandum est, ut filius, „ duntaxat qui est in potestate, „ ex aliqua parte fit heres institutus. nam frustra exheredabitur post mortē suam. quod est „ nō {*}esse necesse in eo filio, qui „ apud hostes est, si ibi decedat: „ & in nepote certè & pronepote. quorum si liberi here-des instituantur, institutione nun-

page.notes: The catchword "nun-" and the lower-left mark "2" are uncertain. The running head is largely illegible. The left-margin note reads "est" beside the reference mark "*" in the text ("nō *esse"). Some words are hyphenated at line ends ("here-des", "prone-pote"); the hyphens are kept as printed. Text is set as a quotation with „ marks at the start of each line; these are reproduced as printed.
